Enum Class CameraModel

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<CameraModel>
yall.sim.CameraModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<CameraModel>, Constable
public enum CameraModel extends Enum<CameraModel>
Published specs of common FRC vision cameras, for simulating them. Pass one to VisionCameraConfig.withCameraModel(CameraModel).

Each model simulates its vendor's horizontal and vertical field of view. Smart cameras (Limelight, Luma) run at the AprilTag frame rate their vendor publishes. USB cameras run at their full-resolution capture rate; the coprocessor may track AprilTags slower, so lower it with VisionCameraConfig.withCameraProperties(SimCameraProperties) if yours does. Vendors don't publish fixed latencies, so every model uses an estimate; Limelights report their real latency at runtime.

Sources: the Limelight quick-start pages and hardware comparison at https://docs.limelightvision.io/docs/docs-limelight/getting-started/, the Luma P1 docs at https://docs.luma.vision/p1/ and Luma P2 page at https://luma.vision/products/luma-p2, The Thrifty Bot's docs at https://docs.thethriftybot.com/thriftycam and https://docs.thethriftybot.com/thriftiest-cam, Arducam's B0332 quick start guide, AndyMark's am-5170 page and ELP's ELP-USB8MP02G-L180 listing.

    • LIMELIGHT_3G

      public static final CameraModel LIMELIGHT_3G
      Limelight 3G: OV9281 global shutter, 82° by 56.2°, AprilTags at about 20 fps at full resolution. Limelight lists the AprilTag rate at 1280x960, which the 1280x800 sensor can't produce, so this simulates 1280x800.

    • LIMELIGHT_4

      public static final CameraModel LIMELIGHT_4

    • THRIFTYCAM

      public static final CameraModel THRIFTYCAM
      ThriftyCam with its stock 80° lens: OmniVision OG02B1B global shutter, 1600x1304 at 70 fps (firmware 5.10 or newer). The lens is specified as 71° by 48° on a different image size; on this sensor its 4.1 mm focal length and 3 µm pixels give 60.7° by 51°, which this simulates.

    • THRIFTIEST_CAM

      public static final CameraModel THRIFTIEST_CAM
      Thriftiest Cam: OV9281 global shutter, 1280x800 at 120 fps, 82° by 56°.

    • ARDUCAM_OV9281

      public static final CameraModel ARDUCAM_OV9281
      Arducam OV9281 USB camera (B0332), the common PhotonVision camera: 1280x800 at 100 fps, 70° horizontal field of view. Arducam's manual says 120 fps and resellers say 100, so this uses 100. Arducam doesn't give the vertical field of view, so it comes from the 16:10 sensor: 47.3°.

    • ELP_FISHEYE

      public static final CameraModel ELP_FISHEYE
      AndyMark ELP Fisheye Lens Camera (am-5170, ELP-USB8MP02G-L180): Sony IMX179 color rolling shutter with a 180° fisheye lens, simulated at 1280x960 and 20 fps (ELP's rate for that mode; 3264x2448 runs at 15 fps).

      PhotonVision simulates a pinhole lens, which can't see 180°. This model keeps the real lens's magnification at the center of the image instead: a fisheye with 180° across 1280 pixels has a focal length of about 407 pixels, and a pinhole lens with that focal length sees 115° by 99.4°. Tags near the center look the size they would on the real camera; tags at the edges of the real camera's view aren't simulated. Calibrate the real camera before trusting its poses.
